## Talk it through with Gemini, now on Apple CarPlay

Get more done on your daily drive with hands-free conversations, daily briefings, inbox catch-ups, and on-the-go brainstorming.

We are bringing Gemini Live to Apple CarPlay so you can have natural, hands-free conversations while driving. You can use this tool to manage your calendar, summarize emails, or brainstorm ideas during your commute. Update your Gemini app on your iPhone, enable microphone permissions, and tap the Gemini icon on your car display to start your first conversation.

• We are bringing the Gemini app to Apple CarPlay for natural conversations while you drive safely.

• You can now use Gemini Live to manage your calendar, check emails, and plan your day.

• Our app lets you brainstorm ideas or practice presentations while you travel in your own car.

• Your conversations sync to your iPhone, so you can access your notes after you finish driving.

• Please update your Gemini app and enable microphone permissions to start using this feature today globally.

We are bringing Gemini Live to Apple CarPlay so you can have natural, hands-free conversations while driving. You can use your voice to summarize emails, check your calendar, or practice for upcoming meetings without taking your eyes off the road. Because these chats sync with your iPhone, you can easily pick up where you left off once you park. It is a simple way to stay productive and prepared during your daily commute.

## Explore other styles:

For millions of people, the daily commute averages about an hour behind the wheel. While voice assistants have long been great for quick tasks like playing a playlist or getting directions home, all that quiet time on the road is also an opportunity to catch up, prepare for what’s ahead, or simply think out loud.

Following our rollout on Android Auto and cars with Google built-in , today we’re bringing the Gemini app directly to Apple CarPlay. Now, iOS users can have natural, free-flowing conversations with Gemini Live right from their car’s display — hands-free, so you can get more done while keeping your hands on the wheel and your eyes on the road.

## Pick up where you left off — or start a fresh conversation

We designed Gemini on CarPlay to work like a conversational driving companion that minimizes distraction. When you tap the Gemini app icon on your CarPlay screen or side rail, you can easily pick up where you left off with a recent chat or start a fresh conversation.

You can talk back and forth with Gemini at your own pace — interrupting to add a detail, changing the subject, or pausing when you need to focus on an exit.

## Make the most of your drive

Whether you’re commuting or setting out on a road trip, Gemini on CarPlay helps you be more productive during your ride. Here are a few ways to make the most of your drive:

• Get ready for the day ahead: Use your morning commute to see what's coming up and walk into your first meeting prepared. Ask Gemini what's on your calendar, when you need to leave for your next appointment, or talk through what you want to say before you arrive. Try saying: "What does my day look like?" or "Help me prep for my 10am with the design team."

• Talk through your inbox: Because Gemini connects with your Google Workspace apps like Gmail and Google Calendar, you can ask for your daily brief 1 , catch up on unread emails, get quick summaries of long email threads, and talk through a quick reply using just your voice. Try saying: “Give me my daily brief for today,” or “Catch me up on my unread emails and summarize Sarah’s Q4 budget thread.”

• Explore local spots and landmarks: Ask Gemini for recommendations in the area you’re heading to, from a quick place to grab lunch to the backstory on a local landmark. Try saying: “What’s a quick lunch spot in downtown Austin that’s easy to get in and out of?”

• Brainstorm, rehearse, and learn out loud: A quiet car cabin is one of the best places to think out loud. Use Gemini Live as a sounding board to practice an upcoming presentation, prepare for a tough conversation, or break down a complex topic you’ve been curious about. Try saying: “Let’s roleplay my Q4 pitch — act as a skeptical VP and challenge my strategy,” or “Break down how solid-state EV batteries work in simple terms.”

And because your CarPlay conversations sync automatically with the Gemini app on your iPhone, every summary, note, and brainstorm is waiting in your chat history the moment you park.

## Get started today

Gemini on Apple CarPlay is rolling out globally starting today to all Gemini users on iOS across every supported Gemini Live language.

To get started, make sure you’ve updated to the latest version of the Gemini app on your iPhone, enabled microphone permissions, and used Gemini Live on your phone at least once. The next time you connect your phone to your car, tap the Gemini icon on your CarPlay display, then start a new conversation or pick up a recent one.

## Get the latest news from Google in your inbox

Sign up for our newsletters with product updates, event information, special offers, and more.

Done. Just one step more.

Check your inbox to confirm your subscription.

You can also subscribe with a different email address .

Your information will be used in accordance with Google's privacy policy. You may opt out at any time.

أعلنت Google عن وصول تطبيق Gemini إلى Apple CarPlay، ليتمكن مستخدمو iPhone من إجراء محادثات صوتية طبيعية مع Gemini Live مباشرة من شاشة السيارة، دون استخدام اليدين.

• إدارة التقويم وتلخيص الرسائل الإلكترونية وتخطيط اليوم أثناء القيادة.
• العصف الذهني للأفكار أو التدرّب على العروض التقديمية خلال التنقل.
• يمكن بدء محادثة جديدة أو متابعة محادثة سابقة بالضغط على أيقونة Gemini في شاشة CarPlay.
• تتزامن المحادثات مع iPhone، ما يتيح الرجوع إلى الملاحظات بعد التوقف.
• للبدء: حدّث تطبيق Gemini على iPhone وفعّل إذن الميكروفون.
• يأتي الإطلاق بعد طرح الميزة على Android Auto والسيارات المزوّدة بخدمات Google المدمجة.

تكمن أهمية الخطوة في تحويل وقت التنقل اليومي إلى وقت منتج مع الحفاظ على تركيز السائق على الطريق.
